subject: Renewal accelerator scheduling — compressed hour & procurement gating
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@northfork.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: compact renewal walkthrough

Markus —

Thanks again for the last check-in. Our leadership asked whether we can compress the upcoming Renewal QBR to a 60-minute "accelerator" session instead of the usual 90–120 to reduce exec calendar friction. The goals would be:
- Quick health check (10 min)
- Roadmap highlights + product fit for expansion (30 min)
- Contract/procurement next steps (20 min)

Two constraints on our side: procurement wants a clean SOW outline before any exec time is committed, and one of our VPs has a hard blackout window the week of Dec 8. Can your team run a tight, demo-focused rehearsal (no more than 60 minutes) and send a single SOW snapshot we can take to procurement?

Proposed windows (PST): Dec 10 10:00–11:00, Dec 11 14:00–15:00. Open to other suggestions.

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Patel
Director of Platform Partnerships
Northfork Labs
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@northfork.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: compact renewal walkthrough

Raj —

Appreciate the clarity and the constraints. We can absolutely run a 60-minute accelerator format. Outline looks good; will tighten the roadmap highlights to be demo-first.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I’ll draft a one-page SOW snapshot and attach it for procurement review (expected by EOD Dec 3).
- Ben will run a 30-minute internal dry-run with the product engineer to compress the demo to 20–25 mins and surface any tech pre-reqs.
- Marissa will own the calendar arbitration and finalize a single window.

Can you confirm which of your procurement contacts should receive the SOW? If it helps, we can propose a fallback date Dec 12 in case the blackout or approvals push things.

Attaching a working agenda (renewal_agenda_v1.pdf) and a skeleton SOW (SOW_outline_v2.docx).

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Director — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), SOW_outline_v2.docx (DOCX)
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: compact renewal walkthrough

Looping in my quick checklist from product/engineering side so we don’t overrun the 60 minutes during the live session:
- Primary demo flow: 20 min (prompt pipelines, routing policy demo, cost/latency tradeoff slide + quick live token trace)
- Q&A: 15 min focused on procurement/ops questions (audit logs, retention, VPC options)
- Exec summary + next steps: 10–15 min

Pre-reqs for Northfork: a short config screenshot (or read-only access) to validate routing policies and a preferred example prompt set. If procurement needs the SOW earlier, I can annotate the tech appendix to include estimated instance sizing and the quantization/latency notes.

I’m available for the dry-run on Dec 8 09:00–09:30 PST (we can record). If that conflicts with the VP blackout you mentioned, I can do Dec 9 at the same slot.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@northfork.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@northfork.com
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: compact renewal walkthrough

Markus —

Thanks — this reads well. Procurement is procurement@northfork.com (copied). They asked that the SOW snapshot include: term length, data residency notes, and an estimated monthly committed spend band. If you can flag any optional line items (e.g., extended observability retention, private deployment onboarding) that would speed approvals.

Confirmed preferred window: Dec 11 14:00–15:00 PST. VP blackout knocks out the Dec 10 option. Dec 12 is a fine fallback.

We’ll plan to attend the internal dry-run if you can record it — request submitted to our internal calendar.

See you then,
Raj
